label: Alpine Timeline
description: Alpine timeline — friendly mobile-marketing card: a milestone timeline with a spine + dots that draw down/across, each event a date + title + description. Standalone Alpine brand flavor. v2 rebuilds the geometry as a RATIO layout (nested proportional splits with insetNode-centered dots) so it composes at any canvas without the absolute-placement precision blowup.

events.label: Events
events.description: Timeline events (top→bottom). Each: an optional date, a title, an optional description + color.

orientation.label: Orientation
orientation.description: Layout direction. auto → horizontal on a wide card, vertical on square/tall.

color.label: Accent color
color.description: Spine + dot accent color. Defaults to the theme primary.

anim.renderMode.label: Render mode
anim.renderMode.description: "premium" (default): dots/spine/text fade in — a geq each. "light": the same cascade via free enable-gate pops — no geq, composable, cheap when nested.

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Skip motion; render the final static card.

anim.introFrac.label: Intro length
anim.introFrac.description: Share of the clip the intro fills (the rest holds).

theme.slug.label: Producer slug
theme.slug.description: Producer template to seed tokens from (e.g. "@m0saic/theming/v1").

theme.namespace.label: Namespace
theme.namespace.description: Upstream alias to read tokens from. Default "theme".

theme.forceFetch.label: Force fetch
theme.forceFetch.description: Re-seed via the slug even if the namespace is populated.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Opt into a theme source. Uses the alpine preset by default; set a producer slug + namespace to pull shared design tokens. Explicit color props still win.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only: draw the layout contract (dots equal-size, event text fits its slot) instead of the card.
